scenes.title: Стрелы Купидона  (Cupid's Arrows)
scenes.summary: After the birthday party spiked with miracle drops, Denis brings Katya breakfast in bed, and Katya wakes up horrified and orders him to work.

scenes.title: Просьба о конфиденциальности  (A Request for Confidentiality)
scenes.summary: German wakes up horrified after spending the night with Ainura and begs her to keep it a secret, while Chef Barinov wakes up beside Eva.

scenes.title: Племянница из Владивостока  (The Niece from Vladivostok)
scenes.summary: At Lyova's apartment, Lyova is shocked that Chef Barinov slept with young waitress Eva, and Barinov tells Lyova's mother that Eva is his niece.

scenes.title: Билет на свидание  (Ticket for a Date)
scenes.summary: Katya tells Denis he has zero chance with her, so Denis writes his phone number on a fifty-ruble bill and bets that fate will bring it back to her.

scenes.title: Как зубы почистить  (Like Brushing Your Teeth)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov worries about his age gap with young waitress Eva, and Lyova advises him that young people treat sex as casually as brushing teeth.

scenes.title: Пропавшие загустители  (The Missing Thickeners)
scenes.summary: Katya discovers that Senya and Fedya ruined her molecular cuisine thickeners before tonight's show-kitchen, and Denis volunteers to fetch new ones.

scenes.title: Неудачное сравнение  (An Unfortunate Comparison)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov meets with waitress Eva and foolishly repeats Lyova's line that their night together was just like brushing teeth, offending her.

scenes.title: Разговор с Айнурой  (The Talk with Ainura)
scenes.summary: Ainura comes to German's office to talk about their night together, silences his excuses, and dramatically breaks up with him first.

scenes.title: Тонкий шантаж Евы  (Eva's Subtle Blackmail)
scenes.summary: Eva chats with Katya right in front of Chef Barinov about spending the night with an older man, forcing Barinov to beg for her silence.

scenes.title: Подозрительные порошки  (Suspicious Powders)
scenes.summary: On his way back to the restaurant with packets of white molecular cuisine powders, Denis is stopped and detained by a police patrol.

scenes.title: Разговор отца с Катей  (A Father's Talk with Katya)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov goes to the kitchen to confess about Eva to Katya, but loses his nerve when Katya calls Eva's older lovers perverts.

scenes.title: Допрос в полиции  (Police Interrogation)
scenes.summary: At the police station, officers interrogate Denis over the agar-agar powder until a senior officer suddenly releases him.

scenes.title: Операция «Ураган»  (Operation Hurricane)
scenes.summary: The two detectives reveal they released Denis to tail him to the big bosses, and when they spot Timur at Claude Monet, they go undercover.

scenes.title: Магия молекулярной кухни  (The Magic of Molecular Cuisine)
scenes.summary: While Eva charms Lyova's mother at home, German and Katya present the molecular show-kitchen at Claude Monet under the eyes of the detectives.

scenes.title: Оговорка за ужином  (A Slip of the Tongue at Dinner)
scenes.summary: At Lyova's apartment, Eva accidentally mentions living in Moscow for two years, and Lyova's mother assumes Eva is Lyova's secret girlfriend.

scenes.title: Жидкая курица и группа захвата  (Liquid Chicken and the Arrest Team)
scenes.summary: At the molecular show-kitchen, the two detectives taste Katya's liquid chicken, feel their hearts racing, and call in a tactical squad.

scenes.title: Бегство на шоу-китчен  (Escape to the Show-Kitchen)
scenes.summary: When Eva starts describing her older lover with a cigar to Lyova's mother, Chef Barinov drags everyone out to Katya's show-kitchen.

scenes.title: Полковник в зале  (A Colonel in the Dining Room)
scenes.summary: When the undercover detectives raid Katya's molecular show-kitchen, they discover a police colonel dining among the guests and report a drug den.

scenes.title: Старый друг полковник  (An Old Friend the Colonel)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov recognizes the police colonel as his old friend Yura, clears Katya's name, and watches Katya angrily reject Denis's apology.

scenes.title: Двадцать тысяч за полтинник  (Twenty Thousand for a Fifty-Ruble Bill)
scenes.summary: Katya softens when she sees Denis's bruised eye, and Denis secretly pays a bartender twenty thousand rubles to hand his fifty-ruble note to Katya.
